Hi Samuel —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Helpful to hear more about the compliance constraints and the volume/latency profile you expect for the patient data pipelines. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: schedule a 60–75 minute technical architecture review + demo of Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem options) focused on network, KMS, and audit/logging.
- Attendees we recommend: your infra lead + security (for network/KMS details); our Solutions Architect (Marissa) and infra lead (Rishi).
- Prep items: high-level network diagram (subnets, current peering/VPN), expected QPS and peak concurrent sessions, and any regulatory constraints (retention/audit windows).

Proposed windows (US central times):
- Tue Nov 17, 10:00–11:15 CT
- Tue Nov 17, 15:00–16:15 CT
- Wed Nov 18, 09:00–10:15 CT

If none of these work, tell me a couple of windows that do and we’ll accommodate. I’ve attached a short agenda and a starter mutual action plan (MAP) so we can capture owners and timelines.

Also looping in Rishi and Marissa who will lead the technical walkthrough. Rishi, Marissa — any particular artifacts you want from MedFusion ahead of the call?

Thanks,
Naomi

Hi Sam —

Appreciate you sending the diagram earlier today. Two quick technical asks ahead of the demo: 

1) Can you confirm whether MedFusion requires bidirectional VPC peering or if a one-way peering with NAT/Egress rules is acceptable for telemetry/log export?
2) Do you have a preferred instance family for running inference (we typically validate on A10/A100 for early sizing, but can test on customer-preferred SKUs if needed)?

If you can drop answers (or call out unknowns) in the MAP by EOD Monday we’ll tailor the demo to sizing and kernel/quantization tradeoffs.

Thanks — Rishi

Naomi/Rishi —

Thanks for the session earlier — Lina and Arjun said it was very helpful. Quick answers to Rishi’s questions:
- One-way peering with NAT for egress telemetry is preferred (we cannot open inbound peering to our production subnets).
- For sizing, start sizing guidance against A10-equivalent, we currently have G5 instances for some workloads but prefer cost-conscious sizing first.

Looping in Procurement (procurement@medfusion.com) for next steps on SO and any NDA/contract redlines. Procurement, we expect to move to a dedicated contract for predictable capacity if the POC aligns; Naomi will share an initial SOW/consumption template.

Sam
